svg.title: A matched view preserves the comparison
svg.desc: Two identical epithelial sections are displayed at a shared scale. The left annotation identifies cellular organisation; the right identifies the basal interface. Only the annotation changes. The figure does not depict disease, treatment, before-and-after improvement or measured clinical data.

text.tspan: A matched view preserves the comparison
The same tissue geometry, shown at the same scale, supports two reading tasks
Matched explanatory views; not patient observations. Geometry, orientation and magnification are fixed. Only the selected label
changes; no disease or treatment effect is implied.
